reviews.author: RyanM

reviews.title: NZXT "Flow' case, lives up to its name
reviews.comment: The NZXT cases, like the H6, make them a good competitor as NZXT not only specialize in fans and electronics, but they've built towers with consumers concerns, thus creating these and other cases, with the air "Flow" in mind to stabilize the temperature inside a high-end pc build, and at the same time thinking of organization and aesthetics. If you need a mid-tower that fits big cards, with AIO's cooling systems, that also manages temps like a pro, and keeps everything nice and organized (cables), look no more.
